mentions.name: Tidepools
mentions.description: Tidepools is a local-first daily journaling and task management app for Mac, iOS, and web with a proactive AI coach that asks the user questions and can suggest tasks. Sandboxable plugins are in development that the coach can modify, letting users request behavior changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Tidepools, a daily journaling / task management app (local-first, Mac/iOS/web) with a proactive AI coach. Mostly what the coach does is ask you questions. It can also suggest tasks. Right now I'm working on sandboxed plugins that the coach can modify, so the user can request behavior changes.
